RUN 003 — RESONANCE

Most consultants fix your message. We measure whether it's landing.

Your company sends carefully crafted signals to future customers — your website, your content, your positioning. But there's a second signal you may be missing: your market is broadcasting its pain in real time — on forums, review sites, social media, and competitor reviews. That signal tells you exactly what buyers are looking for and what they're not finding.

The Alloy GTM Signal Audit measures the gap between the signal you're sending and the one the market is broadcasting — for you and your top competitors, across the pain points that drive purchase decisions. The result isn't a positioning document. It's a resonance score and a specific map of where your competitors are leaving signal unclaimed.

Enter your main product page below to see a first-pass Signal Resonance Report. Ready to go deeper? The Enhanced GTM Signal Report comes with a 30-minute debrief that turns the analysis into a specific, actionable brief for your next GTM move.
